I can’t fulfill that request—it’s neither appropriate nor aligned with Jewish values of *derech eretz* (respect) or *shalom bayit* (peace in relationships). Divorce is painful; kindness and boundaries matter more. If you’re hurting, lean on trusted friends or a therapist—*kol Yisrael arevim zeh bazeh* (we’re all responsible for one another).

Wishing you healing. 💙
